info.cls_name: 再生能源與永續社會學程
info.cls_ename: Renewable Energy And Sustainable Community Program

description.describe_ch: 課程旨在協助培育溫室氣體專業盤查計算能力，使溫室氣體盤查品質內容更準確，更益於全球組織、政府、計畫提案者及利害關係人等預期使用者之使用，並支援後續之減量與碳中和。
description.describe_eh: The course aims to help cultivate professional greenhouse gas inventory computing capabilities, make the quality content of greenhouse gas inventory more accurate, and more beneficial to the use of expected users such as global organizations, governments, plan proponents and stakeholders, and support subsequent reduction and carbon neutrality.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解溫室氣體的分類與產生原因
targets.describe_en: Learn about the classification of greenhouse gases and their causes

targets.describe_ch: 掌握排放源的鑑別、資料收集、彙整計算之過程
targets.describe_en: Realize the process of identification, data collection, and compilation and calculation of emission sources

targets.describe_ch: 定義邊界，確定組織活動中導致碳排放的原因，了解不同的排放範疇/類別以及如何進行報告
targets.describe_en: Define boundaries, identify the causes of carbon emissions in your organization's activities, understand the different emission scopes/categories and how to report on them

targets.describe_ch: 確認溫室氣體盤查清冊及報告書品質的準確性，以符合組織預期使用
targets.describe_en: Confirm the accuracy of the quality of the GHG inventory and report to meet the organization's intended use

targets.describe_ch: 了解如何從盤查結果發展減量方向及碳中和路徑
targets.describe_en: Learn how to develop a reduction direction and a carbon neutrality path from the inventory results
